title: 第7章  夫人，你怎么了？
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
矿洞内别有洞天。
两侧岩壁上镶嵌着发光的萤石。
将这里照得幽暗而诡异，摊位杂乱无章。
摆摊修士大多遮头盖脸，但也有固定店面的店家。
摆摊的修士背景比较弱。
但是那些固定店面的店家，能稳定在黑市存在，都是背景相当强大的。
黑市卖的东西也是五花八门。
有杀人越货染血法器，有来路不明的丹药，甚至还有被锁链锁着的女修。这些女修一般都是被卖来当炉鼎的，炉鼎在修炼界有很大的市场，基本上一出现，就很快会被买走。
李长生瞥了一眼被铁链绑着的炉鼎。
禁不住皱了皱眉头。
这么润的姑娘。
被人抓来当炉鼎真是可怜啊？
李长生想到一个问题，如果自己不够强的话，以后江翠萍和宁宁，会不会也沦落到这个下场？
所以……
我要变强。
绝不能让这种事情发生。
李长生想着想着，道心越发坚定。
随后深吸一口气。
压下情绪。
随意走到一个收灵符的摊位前面。

摊主是个浑身裹在黑袍里的老头，面前摆着几块不知名的矿石，和残缺的法决，旁边立着一块牌子，上面写着牛四收灵符。
“收灵符吗？”
李长生压低声音问。
牛四抬起眼皮，扫了眼前的黑大汉一眼，面无表情地回答：
“收。”
李长生袖袍一挥，三张泛着淡金色流光的灵符，落在摊位上。
牛四伸出手抓起一张灵符，
仔细端详。
眼睛顿时瞪圆了。
这是二阶金刚符？
这灵符的防御力比二阶的金刚符还要强三成。
好东西啊！
牛四抬头，看着李长生，淡淡地问：“道友，这灵符是你画的？”
李长生冷哼一声：“不该问的别问。”
牛四闻言，讪笑一声，自己坏了规矩，连忙换上笑脸：
“是老朽唐突了。”
“这灵符品质极佳。”
“我收了。”
“市面上二阶符箓一般是二十灵石一张，老朽出二十五一张，你看如何？”
李长生心中冷笑。

奸商啊！
这种品质的符箓，在拍卖行起码能卖到三十五一张。
“三十灵石。”李长生冷冷道。
“道友，这……”
“三十灵石，不二价。如果你不要的话，我就走了。”李长生作势要收回符箓。
“行行行。”
“三十就三十。”
牛四肉痛地答应下来。
只要吃下这批灵符，转手卖出去的话，都能赚不少。
见牛四同意了。
李长生将背包里剩下的灵符都倒出来。
一共二十张二阶灵符。
“一共二十张二阶灵符。”
“六百块灵石。”
“麻烦给一下。”
李长生声音嘶哑，一副生人勿近的样子。
牛四打量了眼前的黑大汉两眼，鼻子吸了吸，好像想到了什么，也没有废话，丢过来一个储物袋。
“里面正好六百块灵石。”
“你点一下。”
“储物袋就送你了。”

李长生接过，灵识往里面扫视了一眼，确定没有错，就快速离开了。
六百灵石再加上加上之前的积蓄。
差不多有一千块灵石了。
这在散修中。
已是一笔巨款。
交易完成后。
李长生没有急着离开。
先在在鬼市转悠了几圈，确定没人跟踪后，来到了一家名为【百宝阁】的固定店铺。
与此同时。
牛四看着李长生消失在自己面前，脸色忽然阴沉了起来。
只因刚刚李长生拿出灵符的时候，其闻到了一股合欢宗特有的合欢血气。
这种合欢血气，只有杀死合欢宗的人，才会染上的。
如果将之举报给合欢宗。
可是有奖励的。
牛四连忙捏碎传音符。
将消息传递给附近的合欢宗据点。
天真啊！
你以为我的储物袋真的那么好拿的吗？
你拿了我的储物袋。
我就能定位到你的位置。

牛四嘴角喃喃一声，等了片刻，确定李长生走远了，才寻着储物袋的气息，慢慢跟上去。
另一边。
李长生走进【百宝阁】，便直奔佩戴饰物区。
目标很明确，就是购买灵鹿奶，以及【敛息佩】
逛了一会。
百宝阁何掌柜就迎了上来。
虽然何掌柜是凡人，但却没有人敢对百宝阁动手。
可想而知。
背后实力有多强。
何掌柜笑了笑问：“客官想要点什么？”
李长生直接提出自己的需求。
“我要十罐【灵鹿奶】，以及适合女童佩戴的【敛息佩】。”
何掌柜一愣。
灵鹿奶还好说，不但可以喂养灵童，而且温和滋补，很多女修买来养颜。
但适合女童佩戴的【敛息佩】真的很少。
市场少。
物品稀缺。
百宝阁没有这东西。
何掌柜愣了一下，想了想开口：
“【灵鹿奶】十块灵石一罐。但【敛息佩】，我这里没有。”

李长生闻言，稍微有点失望。
他这次的目标主要就是【敛息佩】啊！
店家没有。
他也没有办法。
这时何掌柜的声音又传过来了。
“虽然我这里没有【敛息佩】，但是刚刚收了一块灵玉，名为【暖玉锁灵佩】。同样有遮掩气息，温养经脉之效，适合体弱的女童佩戴，就是价格稍微贵点。”
李长生闻言，愣了一下。
【暖玉锁灵佩】可是比【敛息佩】更高级的东西。
能够遮掩金丹期修士的查探。
这可是好东西啊！
“多少钱？”
“五百灵石。”何掌管回答。
李长生闻言，皱了皱眉头。
五百灵石确实贵。
筑基修士都不一定能赚到五百灵石。
李长生刚赚了不少，而且价格也在接受范围内。
“我买了。”
“好勒。我这就帮你包起来。”
何掌柜笑吟吟地说着，便去拿灵鹿奶，以及【暖玉锁灵佩】。
李长生接过何掌柜递过来的东西，确定无误之后，收进储物袋。

然后将牛四给自己的储物袋和灵石。
原封不动地递过去。
“这里是六百灵石。”
“你点一下有没有错？”
何掌柜倒没有客气，认真清点了一遍。
“数目没错。”
“我这就将灵石倒出来，把储物袋还给你。”
一个储物袋可是价值三十到五十灵石呢！
百宝阁没有占客人便宜的习惯。
李长生却挥挥手。
学着刚刚牛四的语气开口：
“不用了。”
“储物袋就送你们了。”
没等何掌管有反应便退了出去。
留下何掌柜在原地面面相觑。
这可是价值几十灵石的储物袋。
说不要就不要了？
其实李长生并没有发现储物袋被人做了手脚。
只是习惯性保持警惕。
还有就是……

他的确也没有占别人便宜的习惯。
李长生从百宝阁出来之后，警惕四周，见没有人注意，便迅速走到角落，使用隐身符，隐去了身影。
这也是他的习惯。
必须确定没有被人跟踪。
才能返回安置区。
十几分钟后。
都没有跟踪的人出现。
李长生松了一口气，看来我还是太小心了，只不过是在黑市买点东西而已，又没有暴露出什么财富，怎么会被人盯上呢？
李长生正准备换一副装扮，返回安置区。
脸色变了变。
因为其灵识中，看到牛四和一位年轻的男子，联袂出现。
这不对劲啊！
李长生为了保险起见，又往自己身上拍了一张二阶的隐身符。
这时牛四和那位年轻男子的对话传过来。
“你确定发现了带有合欢血气的人吗？”
“沈公子。我很确定没错。虽然这种气息很淡。但是当黑大汉接过我的储物袋时。我很确定没感应错。而且此时那个黑大汉现在就在百宝阁里面，咱们进去试验一下便知。”
“很好。只要你提供的消息是对的。合欢宗不会亏待你的。”
那位沈公子便和牛四走进了百宝阁。
李长生听到这里，脸色难看。
该死啊！

这是狗鼻子吗？
这都能发现了呢？
而且还把我举报给了合欢宗。
而且储物袋应该也有问题。
要不然他们不会那么精准地定位到百宝阁的。
还好我足够小心。
将储物袋送给了百宝阁。
还隐藏在四周观察。
否则连怎么死都不知道。
修仙界还是太危险了。
我只不过是来一趟黑市，就差点死了。
看来非必要的话，不能再出来了。
藏底牌。
藏神通。
默默地发展家族才是王道。
李长生没有等牛四和合欢宗的年轻男子出来，就迅速离开了。
三十六计走为上计。
我又没有露出真面目。
刚刚他们找的是黑大汉。
关我李长生什么事？

回到家时。
天已微亮。
李长生走进房间，看着床上熟睡的妻女。
那颗不安的心才稍微安定了一些。
江翠萍躺在床上熟睡。
女儿卷缩在母亲怀中。
时不时嗦一口小手丫。
李长生将【暖玉锁灵佩】挂在女儿的脖子上。看着玉佩发出柔和的光芒，将自家姑娘的异常，全都遮掩过去，这才松了口气。
日子一天天过去。
安置区气氛变得越发诡异。
原本这里是没人管的贫民窟。
但最近好几个老邻居莫名其妙地失踪了。
周围修士人人自危。
颇有一种风雨欲来的感觉。
到底发生了什么事呢？
安置区怎么就乱了起来呢？
李长生很无奈。
更加深居简出了。
每天苟着家里，陪老婆孩子热炕头。
除了偶尔去买些生活必需品，几乎不出门。

有一个好消息，就是李以宁诞生后第二个月，江翠萍又怀孕了。老二已经在路上。这让李长生更加小心了。
content_en:
There is a unique cave in the mine.
The rock walls on both sides are inlaid with luminous fluorite.
It makes the place dark and strange, and the stalls are messy.
Most of the monks who run stalls cover their heads, but there are also shops with fixed storefronts.
The monks who set up stalls have relatively weak backgrounds.
But those stores with fixed stores that can stably exist in the black market have a very strong background.
There are also a wide variety of things sold on the black market.
There are blood-stained magic weapons for killing people, elixirs of unknown origin, and even female nuns who are chained. These female cultivators are usually sold as furnace cauldrons. There is a huge market in the cultivation world for furnace cauldrons. Basically, as soon as they appear, they will be bought up quickly.
Li Changsheng glanced at the furnace cauldron tied with iron chains.
I couldn't help but frown.
Such a smooth girl.
Isn't it really pitiful to be caught and used as a furnace?
Li Changsheng thought of a question. If he was not strong enough, would Jiang Cuiping and Ning Ning end up in the same fate in the future?
So...
I want to become stronger.
This must not be allowed to happen.
As Li Changsheng thought about it, his Taoist heart became more determined.
Then take a deep breath.
Suppress your emotions.
Randomly walk to a stall that collects talismans.
The owner of the stall is an old man wrapped in a black robe. In front of him are several unknown ores and incomplete spells. Next to it is a sign that reads Niu Si Sheng Talisman.
"Collect the talisman?"
Li Changsheng asked in a low voice.
Niu Si raised his eyelids, glanced at the big black man in front of him, and replied expressionlessly:
"Take it."
Li Changsheng waved his sleeves, and three talismans glowing with light golden light landed on the stall.
Niu Si stretched out his hand and grabbed a magic talisman.
Look carefully.
His eyes suddenly widened.
Is this a second-order diamond talisman?
The defensive power of this spiritual talisman is 30% stronger than the second-level diamond talisman.
What a good thing!
Niu Si raised his head, looked at Li Changsheng, and asked calmly: "Fellow Taoist, did you draw this talisman?"
Li Changsheng snorted coldly: "Don't ask what you shouldn't ask."
Niu Si heard this and laughed sarcastically. He broke the rules and quickly put on a smiling face:
"It's just old age and rudeness."
"This talisman is of excellent quality."
"I'll take it."
"The second-level talismans on the market usually cost 20 spirit stones each, but Lao Chan offers 25 spiritual stones each. What do you think?"
Li Changsheng sneered in his heart.
What a profiteer!
Talismans of this quality can be sold for at least thirty-five pieces in the auction house.
"Thirty spirit stones." Li Changsheng said coldly.
"Fellow Taoist, this..."
"Thirty spiritual stones, no two prices. If you don't want it, I'll leave." Li Changsheng made a gesture to take back the talisman.
"Okay, okay, okay."
"Thirty is thirty."
Niu Si Rou agreed painfully.
As long as you eat these talismans and resell them, you can make a lot of money.
See Niu Si agreed.
Li Changsheng poured out all the remaining talismans in his backpack.
There are twenty second-level talismans in total.
"A total of twenty second-level spiritual talismans."
"Six hundred spiritual stones."
"Please give it."
Li Changsheng's voice was hoarse, and he looked like he should stay away from strangers.
Niu Si looked at the big black man in front of him, took a breath, seemed to have thought of something, and threw over a storage bag without any nonsense.
"There are exactly six hundred spiritual stones in it."
"Click it."
"The storage bag will be given to you."
Li Changsheng took it, glanced inside with his spiritual sense, made sure it was correct, and left quickly.
Six hundred spiritual stones plus the previous savings.
There are almost a thousand spiritual stones.
This is in casual cultivation.
It’s already a huge sum of money.
After the transaction is completed.
Li Changsheng was in no hurry to leave.
After wandering around the ghost market for a few times to make sure no one was following me, I came to a fixed store called [Baobao Pavilion].
at the same time.
Niu Si watched Li Changsheng disappear in front of him, his face suddenly turned gloomy.
Just because when Li Changsheng took out the spiritual talisman just now, he smelled the unique Acacia blood energy of the Acacia sect.This kind of Acacia blood can only be acquired by those who kill the Acacia sect.
If you report it to Hehuan Sect.
But there are rewards.
Niu Si quickly crushed the transmission talisman.
Pass the message to the nearby Hehuan Sect stronghold.
How naive!
Do you think my storage bag is really that easy to hold?
You took my storage bag.
I can locate your location.
Niu Si murmured at the corner of his mouth. After waiting for a moment to make sure that Li Changsheng was gone, he looked for the scent of the storage bag and followed him slowly.
other side.
Li Changsheng walked into [Baobao Pavilion] and went straight to the accessories area.
The goal is very clear, which is to buy Linglu milk and [Lengxi Pendant]
Wandered around for a while.
Shopkeeper He of Baibao Pavilion came forward.
Although Shopkeeper He is a mortal, no one dares to attack Baibao Pavilion.
One can imagine.
How strong is the strength behind it.
Shopkeeper He smiled and asked, "What do you want, sir?"
Li Changsheng directly put forward his needs.
"I want ten cans of [Ling Deer Milk] and [Xi Leng Pendant] suitable for girls to wear."
Shopkeeper He was stunned.
Fortunately, spiritual deer milk can not only feed spiritual children, but is also mild and nourishing. Many female cultivators buy it to maintain their beauty.
But there are really very few [breath-holding pendants] suitable for girls to wear.
The market is small.
Items are scarce.
There is no such thing in Baibao Pavilion.
Shopkeeper He was stunned for a moment, then thought about it and said:
"[Spiritual Deer Milk] contains ten spiritual stones per jar. But [Lingxi Pendant], I don't have it here."
Li Changsheng was a little disappointed when he heard this.
His main goal this time is [Xi Leng Pei]!
The store doesn't have it.
There was nothing he could do.
At this time, Shopkeeper He's voice came again.
"Although I don't have the [Breaking Breath Pendant] here, I just received a piece of spiritual jade called the [Warm Jade Locking Spirit Pendant]. It also has the effect of covering the breath and warming the meridians. It is suitable for weak girls to wear, but the price is a little more expensive."
Li Changsheng was stunned for a moment when he heard this.
[Warm Jade Lock Spirit Pendant] is a more advanced thing than [Breaking Breath Pendant].
It can cover up the detection of the Golden Core Stage monks.
This is good stuff!
"How much?"
"Five hundred spiritual stones." Manager He replied.
Li Changsheng frowned when he heard this.
Five hundred spirit stones are indeed expensive.
Even foundation-building monks may not be able to earn five hundred spirit stones.
Li Changsheng had just made a lot of money, and the price was within an acceptable range.
"I bought it."
"Okay. I'll wrap it up for you right now."
Shopkeeper He said with a smile, then went to get the Linglu Milk and the [Warm Jade Lock Spirit Pendant].
Li Changsheng took the things handed over by shopkeeper He, and after making sure they were correct, he put them into his storage bag.
Then give Niu Si his storage bag and spirit stone.
Hand it over intact.
"Here are the Six Hundred Spiritual Stones."
"Is it wrong for you to click on it?"
Shopkeeper He was not polite and counted them carefully.
"The number is correct."
"I will pour out the spirit stones and return the storage bag to you."
A storage bag is worth thirty to fifty spirit stones!
Baibao Pavilion has no habit of taking advantage of its guests.
Li Changsheng waved his hand.
I imitated Niu Si’s tone just now and said:
"No need."
"I'll give you the storage bag."
The host withdrew before He could react.
Shopkeeper He was left standing there looking at each other.
This is a storage bag worth dozens of spiritual stones.
Just say you don’t want it?
In fact, Li Changsheng did not find that the storage bag had been tampered with.
Just be vigilant out of habit.
And there is...
He indeed has no habit of taking advantage of others.
After Li Changsheng came out of Baibao Pavilion, he was alert to his surroundings. When he saw that no one was paying attention, he quickly walked to the corner and used the invisibility charm to hide his figure.
This is also his habit.
Make sure you are not being followed.
before returning to the resettlement area.
Ten minutes later.
No one was following anyone.
Li Changsheng breathed a sigh of relief. It seems that I was still too careful. I was just buying something on the black market.That's all, and he didn't reveal any wealth, so how could he be targeted?
Li Changsheng was about to change his clothes and return to the resettlement area.
His expression changed.
Because in his spiritual consciousness, he saw Niu Si and a young man appearing together.
This is wrong!
To be on the safe side, Li Changsheng took another second-level invisibility talisman on himself.
At this time, the conversation between Niu Si and the young man came over.
"Are you sure you found someone with the blood of Acacia?"
"Mr. Shen, I'm sure it's true. Although the aura is very weak. But when the big black man took my storage bag, I'm sure I didn't sense it wrong. And at this time, the big black man is in the Baibao Pavilion. Let's go in and test it out."
"Very good. As long as the information you provide is correct. Hehuan Sect will not treat you badly."
Mr. Shen and Niu Si walked into Baibao Pavilion.
Li Changsheng's face turned ugly when he heard this.
Damn it!
Is this a dog's nose?
Can all this be discovered?
And they also reported me to the Hehuan Sect.
And there should be something wrong with the storage bag.
Otherwise, they would not have located Baibao Pavilion so accurately.
Fortunately I was careful enough.
The storage bag was given to Baibao Pavilion.
Still hiding around and observing.
Otherwise, I don’t even know how to die.
The world of immortality is still too dangerous.
I just came to the black market and almost died.
It seems that you can't come out again unless necessary.
Hide your trump card.
Hidden magical powers.
Developing your family quietly is the way to go.
Li Changsheng left quickly without waiting for Niu Si and the young men from the Hehuan Sect to come out.
Thirty-six strategies are the best.
I didn't show my true face.
What they were looking for just now was a big black man.
What does it have to do with me, Li Changsheng?
When returning home.
It's getting light.
Li Changsheng walked into the room and looked at his wife and daughter sleeping soundly on the bed.
The restless heart finally calmed down a little.
Jiang Cuiping was lying on the bed and sleeping soundly.
The daughter curled up in her mother's arms.
From time to time, I lick my little hands.
Li Changsheng hung the [Warm Jade Lock Spirit Pendant] around his daughter's neck. Seeing the jade pendant emitting a soft light, covering up all the abnormalities in his girl, he was relieved.
The days passed.
The atmosphere in the resettlement area became increasingly weird.
Originally this was a neglected slum.
But recently several old neighbors have disappeared inexplicably.
Everyone around the monks was in danger.
There is quite a feeling that a storm is coming.
What happened?
Why is the resettlement area in such chaos?
Li Changsheng was helpless.
He became even more reclusive.
He stays at home every day, spending time with his wife and children.
Except for the occasional shopping for daily necessities, I almost never go out.
The good news is that Jiang Cuiping was pregnant again in the second month after Li Yining was born. The second child is already on the way. This made Li Changsheng even more careful.
